reason: The cave's chambers can send a voice back, suggesting a starting point for the song.
expectation: The call should echo in the cave and help lead toward a song.

effect: The call became an echo, suggesting repeated sounds may help build the song.
reaction: The cave's reflected voice is a satisfying starting point.
reason: A social group can listen to and repeat the echo together.
expectation: The group may turn the echo into shared vocal activity.

effect: Echo combined automatically with Memory to make Song; the social group may now help turn it into separate voices.
reaction: The remembered and altered echo makes a clear transition from sound to song.
reason: The goal calls for separate voices, so I will try bringing the song to the group.
expectation: The group may sing together, completing the goal.

effect: The group turned the song into a chorus, completing the song goal. The cave painting remains.
reaction: The shared pattern makes a satisfying conclusion to the echo sequence.
reason: Earth and water suggest a mixture that could be used as paint for the cave wall.
expectation: They may make a pigment or paint for the image.

effect: Earth and water made pigment; it still needs a painter.
reaction: The material has a clear practical role in the painting.
reason: The social group can use the pigment to make an image.
expectation: The group may use the pigment to create a painting or prepare to paint.

effect: Pigment cannot combine directly with the group, but its listed partner is the sea cave.
reaction: The compatibility feedback makes the next step clear.
reason: The cave is the pigment's listed partner and has walls that can hold an image.
expectation: The pigment will make a mark or painting on the cave wall.

effect: Pigment and memory produced a cave painting, but the impossible-creature goal remains.
reaction: The remembered image is a natural start; I am curious how it becomes impossible.
reason: A story might transform the remembered painting into an imagined creature, though this is a guess.
expectation: The story may add an imagined element to the painting.

effect: The story transformed the painting into an imagined beast, completing that goal and revealing a goal to colour a sky.
reaction: Combining familiar memories into an unseen creature is a satisfying surprise.
reason: The starfield suggests a sky, and pigment may give it colour; this is a guess.
expectation: The pigment may help create a coloured sky.

effect: The pigment worked through the cave with the starfield automatically, creating a painted sky and completing the final goal.
reaction: The impossible stars are a fitting conclusion, though the automatic cave combination was unexpected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Turning a remembered cave painting into an imagined beast made the theme of creators making something new especially clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to give the pigment directly to the group was unproductive; the feedback instead pointed to the cave.

surprise.text: The painted sky required the cave as an intermediary, with the starfield included automatically, rather than the direct pairing I expected.

arbitrary.text: Memory was automatically included in the cave painting, so its role in that particular operation was not apparent beforehand, even though remembering an image makes sense.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what else the inhabitants create independently; the imagined beast and their own painted sky offered an appealing direction.
